svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.title: APS work-item lifecycle
svg.desc: Six steps show APS linting a plan, selecting Ready work, starting it as In Progress, implementing the bounded outcome, running declared validation, and completing the item before continuing the queue.

Declared command" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="96" width="155" x="760" y="125" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="complete" parent="1" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=14;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#26836A;fillColor=#E9F8F2;fontColor=#174F41;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;spacing=10;" value="6 COMPLETE

style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=0;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#52606D;endArrow=block;endFill=1;" target="implement"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge45" edge="1" parent="1" source="implement" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=0;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#52606D;endArrow=block;endFill=1;" target="validate"> <mxGeometry style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=0;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#52606D;endArrow=block;endFill=1;" target="complete"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell
